@s1 stated
  relation "present oneself at the notary public"
  role subject "all the heirs"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "work in"
  role subject "the user's younger brother"
  role object "Parma"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "be able to come"
  role subject "the user's younger brother"

  certainty asserted
  valid until "December"

@a1 assumed
  relation "present oneself at the notary public"
  role subject "the user's younger brother"
  role location "at the notary public Dumitrache from Alexandria"
  polarity negated
  basis implicature

  relation "be present"
  role subject "the user"
  role location "at the notary public Dumitrache from Alexandria"
  polarity affirmed
  basis closure

@a3 assumed
  relation "be present"
  role subject "the user's sibling"
  role location "at the notary public Dumitrache from Alexandria"
  polarity affirmed
  basis closure

@a4 assumed
  relation "be present"
  role subject "the user's sibling"
  role location "at the notary public Dumitrache from Alexandria"
  polarity affirmed
  basis closure

@q query
  where match
    relation "be able to issue"
    role subject "the notary public"
    role object "the certificate of heir"
    role recipient "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be able to issue"
    role subject "the notary public"
    role object "the certificate of heir"
    role recipient "the user's other two siblings"
    polarity affirmed
  end
